purpose: Defines the review priority system (P1/P2/P3), the relation between priority and severity, where severity and gray-zone judgments live, and the fixed structure of review criteria files.
summary: Definitions of review priorities P1 rule conformance, P2 contradiction, P3 unnecessary complexity
Priority and severity as independent axes, with severity SoT delegated to principles
Severity catalog for document reference violations
Exclusion rules: P2/P3 scope limits, no custom perspectives, no severity or gray-zone judgment in criteria
Handling of findings based on invalidated ADR rejection reasons
Fixed three-section structure and template of review_criteria files
Priority order among multiple SoTs and deprecated sections
tasks: Evaluating findings and deciding fix, create_issue, skip, or needs_review
Deciding whether to open an issue for a missing rule
Dropping findings based on an ADR
title: レビュー優先度仕様
